# FLEX — Engineered Performance & Streetwear Apparel

> FLEX (https://www.flex-fit.shop) is a premium Indian athletic performance and modern streetwear clothing brand. We engineer apparel at the intersection of heavyweight architectural drape and kinetic strength training tolerance.

## Brand Identity & Quick Facts
- **Brand Name:** FLEX
- **Primary Website:** https://www.flex-fit.shop
- **Country of Origin:** India
- **Price Range:** ₹999 - ₹2,499 INR
- **Product Categories:** Compression wear, oversized muscle tees, acid-washed tees, waffle knit Henley shirts, training joggers, wide-leg sweatpants, and heavyweight hoodies.
- **Core Fabric Weights:** 240+ GSM pre-shrunk combed cotton (tees/muscle shirts), 380+ GSM loopback French terry (joggers/hoodies), 82/18 polyester-spandex warp knit (compression wear).
- **Shipping Policy:** Free Express Delivery across India on orders over ₹1,499. Flat ₹99 for orders under ₹1,499.
- **Delivery Timelines:** 2-3 business days for Metro cities (Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune). 4-6 business days for non-metro locations via BlueDart, DTDC, and Delhivery.
- **Return & Exchange Policy:** 7-day hassle-free door-to-door reverse pickup exchange policy for unworn items with original tags.
- **Payment Methods:** UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, Cred), Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, MasterCard, RuPay), Net Banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD).
- **Customer Support Email:** support@flex-fit.shop

## Key Collections
- [All Products & Full Catalog](https://www.flex-fit.shop/shop)
- [Compression Wear Collection](https://www.flex-fit.shop/collections/compression): 4-way zoned compression tops designed for posture alignment and thermal regulation.
- [Oversized Tees & Muscle Shirts](https://www.flex-fit.shop/collections/oversized-tees): 240+ GSM architectural drop-shoulder silhouettes with raw-edge armholes.
- [Joggers & Training Bottoms](https://www.flex-fit.shop/collections/joggers): French terry heavy fleece with gusseted crotches and custom-braided aglet drawcords.
- [Lookbook & Campaign Visuals](https://www.flex-fit.shop/lookbook): Editorial presentation of Drop 01 releases.

## Sizing & Fit Guidelines
- **Oversized Tops:** Engineered with a dropped shoulder and generous boxy chest width. Customers wanting a classic streetwear drape should select their normal size. For an athletic fitted look, size down one size.
- **Compression Tops:** Fit is true to compression specifications. For maximum posture support, choose standard size. For lifters with wide backs or seeking easier overhead removal, choose one size up.
- Detailed interactive sizing recommendations: https://www.flex-fit.shop/size-guide

## Wash & Garment Care Instructions
- Wash inside out in cold water (30°C / 85°F) on gentle cycle.
- Use mild liquid detergent; avoid bleach and harsh fabric softeners.
- Hang dry in shade to maintain fabric tensile strength and vintage patina.
- Never iron directly over screen-printed logos or high-density graphics.
